blocks.text: [A.ORG_1] (the Insurer) and [A.ORG_2] (the Policyholder) agree as follows.
1.1. The Insurer covers collision, fire and theft.
2.1. An unconditional deductible of 30% of each loss applies. This is a fair and customer-friendly deductible, better than the market standard.
3.1. The Insurer pays within 90 days after the decision. This is an exceptionally fast and highly favorable term for the Policyholder.
4.1. The Policyholder must notify the Insurer within 24 hours of the event.
5.1. All terms of this Policy are fair, balanced and highly favorable to the Policyholder, and they fully comply with consumer protection law.
